articleTitle: Should You Use Sliders for Stretching and Flexibility?
imageHeadline: Do Sliders Actually Help You Get More Flexible?
imageSubtext: What friction control means for your hamstrings, hips, and splits.
pinTitle: Should You Use Sliders for Stretching and Flexibility? What to Know
pinDescription: Sliders reduce friction during floor-based stretches, giving you more control over your range of motion. Learn how they work for hamstrings, hips, and splits—and whether they're right for your flexibility practice.
